thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx and latency spikes for inference endpoints in us-west-2a. Error pattern: 502/504 + TCP connect timeouts. Autoscaling not recovering for some Dedicated pools. Investigate and page oncall.
Alex Chen: I'm on it, pulling metrics and logs now. See spike at ~1745204700 in token service.
Maria Gomez: seeing same in console. Per-route dashboards show error rate from model-serving-proxy-*/us-west-2a.
Jun Park: copying netstats from a node: `ENETUNREACH` and `connect timeout` to control-plane endpoints. Possible zonal network degradation.
Becca Liu: Can we start failing over traffic to us-west-2b/c? What's the routing policy right now? (we have pinned traffic for some customers)
Alex Chen: Routing policy: route by region+zone affinity. We have automated fallback but it's rate-limited to avoid cold-start spikes. I'll bump fallback window.
Priya Nair: Support: which customers impacted? We need a list for CS and status page.
Support Lead: Early list: three high-volume customers on Dedicated in us-west-2a (cust-112, cust-219, cust-317). They report 5xx and timeouts. We'll draft customer message.
NetOps-Bot: AWS SHD: us-west-2 AZ a reported "network connectivity issues" in some instances. Reference: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incident/US-WEST-2/AZ-network
Alex Chen: Confirmed: EC2 instance-level network impaired in 2a. Some instance types show ENI detach flaps. We're seeing degraded throughput on g5/inf1 instances.
Jun Park: Action plan: 1) Gradually shift new requests to us-west-2b/c by adjusting smart-router policy; 2) Increase capacity of cross-region reserved pools for critical customers; 3) Temporarily lower batch-size/latency SLO to reduce per-request probability of hitting failing nodes.
Becca Liu: Command to adjust router policy (dry-run):
```
curl -XPOST https://router.internal/api/v1/policy/adjust \
  -d '{"from_zone":"us-west-2a","to_zone":["us-west-2b","us-west-2c"],"weight":0.6}'
```
Alex Chen: Already applied a 0.5 weight shift for new sessions. Monitoring error rates. So far 12% traffic moved. Error rate for cust-112 dropped from 18% -> 6%.
Maria Gomez: DNS note: some internal DNS resolvers in 2a are intermittently failing causing control-plane calls to timeout. We're switching critical services to use the regional resolver endpoint instead of AZ-local resolver.
Jun Park: For Dedicated pools pinned to specific AZs, we're triggering live migration: mark affected hosts draining, spin up replacements in 2b/2c. Might hit capacity limits -- need to watch for EC2 AZ capacity issues.
Priya Nair: Support: drafting heads-up to customers: short note about partial degradation in us-west-2a, mitigation steps underway, suggest switching to cross-region config if they need immediate relief.
Support Lead: Copy for customers: "We're seeing zonal network issues impacting inference in us-west-2a. We've started routing traffic to healthy zones; you may see short-lived errors while we migrate pinned capacity. We'll update soon." (ok?)
Becca Liu: +1. Add: "If you require guaranteed single-AZ behavior, our team will coordinate a scheduled migration."
Alex Chen: Observability: adding a temporary SLI that flags ENETUNREACH and >300ms connect times for inference backend. Dashboard updated.
NetOps-Bot: Opened AWS support case 1234567890 (SLA: urgent). AWS acknowledged potential zonal network impairment and is investigating.
Jun Park: Handoff: I'm gonna start an ops burst to spin up cross-region instances; need to hand to next oncall for monitoring. @Jun Park -> oncall handover in 30m. Notes pinned in incident doc: https://confluence.internal/incidents/1745204832
Alex Chen: Current impact: 20% of Dedicated pools in us-west-2a reporting elevated 5xx. Hosted endpoints auto-failed over for new sessions; existing pinned sessions can see errors until drain completes. Estimated full mitigation if AWS recovers or we finish migration: 45-90 minutes.
Maria Gomez: Quick mitigation for low-latency customers: enable model-variant fallback (smaller quantized model) which uses less GPU mem and can be spun up in other AZs faster.
Priya Nair: Support: sending update to affected customers now. I'll include ETA and link to status page.
Support Lead: Status page update posted: "Partial service degradation in us-west-2a affecting inference; mitigation in progress. Customers on dedicated pools may experience errors or degraded throughput."
Becca Liu: Request: after immediate mitigation, run a post-incident analysis on routing policy thresholds. We almost avoided bigger customer impact but pinning logic delayed failover.
Alex Chen: Agreed. Also add a blameless postmortem item: improve DNS resolver fallback and ENI detach detection for earlier automation.
Jun Park: Leaving now, handoff to Maria (next oncall). Maria, logs + commands in incident doc. If SHD updates, escalate to AWS TAM.
Maria Gomez: Taking over. Monitoring dashboards and support. Tagging for followups: #postmortems, #eng-runtime. Thanks all.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT STATUS: Mitigation ongoing, partial failover applied. Next update in 15m or on status change.
